issue_context.title: Add Metrics to Monitor PD API call exection time
issue_context.body:
This issue was reported by @AilinKid 

We should support the ability to time PD API calls so that we can better investigate user reported issues with placement rule DDL. There might be some scenarios where PD API call time takes longer than expected.
comments:
/assign
I think we can just time the [`requestPD(method, uri string, body io.Reader, res interface{}) error`](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/af5b449270128220e1cb559cacb62b43d6dacca9/store/helper/helper.go#L743) function, Is it?

review_comments: You did not count the errored requests in. What about moving observe before `err ...` condition branch.
I add a `enum{common, placement}` label for this metric. Plz correct me if you have a better idea. @xhebox
